uniqueness: The only real SPLiT-seq reads anywhere in the corpus, and the corpus's one worked example of a pre-registered prediction coming true: committed 2026-07-23 as a prediction of a FIX while it still failed, because the constant-segment purity gate rejected linker2 at 0.827. It now grades correct — a constant segment is scored as a share of reads, not a per-cycle purity. Published on whatever colour it is (ADR-0018); if the package ever goes missing the case reports absent (a gap in the corpus), never a network skip.

The corpus's only 10x 3' v2 chemistry, and its only two-lab strain split inside one series (4 UW samples VC2010, 3 UPenn samples N2) — so a shuffled record join surfaces as a wrong strain instead of passing on the multiset. SETTLED 2026-08-01 AT `ask`, and it is the tier's only real-data instance of the KB's one read-undecidable pair: 10x 3' v2 and 10x 5' v1/v2 share the 26 bp geometry AND the 737K-august-2016 whitelist, so every structural rung ties and rung 3 consults one file for both. The suspected cause (this series' over-sequenced SRX5411291) was wrong; the resolver names the pair it stops on. Neither ladder rung is available here — alignment is unbuilt, and no record or the carried paper ever writes 3' or 5' — so the question is a human's. All 7 field claims still grade, chemistry included, because `fields` is checked on `ask`.

The benchmark tier's only refusal (the synthetic ones live in evals/cases/refusal/), and the only irrecoverably barcode-absent dataset anywhere: submitted as Cell Ranger possorted BAMs, so CB/UMI are BAM tags rather than reads and --include-technical cannot recover them. Pins MISSING_TECHNICAL_READ, which no case in either tier covered.

The only package in either tier that CONTAINS index reads (dual-index I1 10bp + I2 10bp beside R1/R2), so it is the only test that a file eligible for no role is left unassigned rather than seated. Every other package is a 2-3 file mirror and every spec recipe generates only the roles its spec declares.

Four FACS-sorted motor-neuron libraries from two reporter strains where strain is the ONLY attribute that differs between samples — so it is the case whose per-accession claim carries the whole anti-shuffle burden. Also the corpus's clearest archive-vs-paper genotype drift (kasIs2 written two ways). GREEN BYTE-ONLY AND UNSTABLE UNDER --llm, explained 2026-08-01: `library.chemistry` is asked of every experiment document, and this series' experiment documents are one GSM title ending "; Caenorhabditis elegans; RNA-Seq" — a library_strategy, not a chemistry, which span-verifies and entails by construction and then matches a bulk KB entry by substring, colliding with the barcoded bytes at exit 4. The earlier `over_ask` and the later `correct` are two draws from one stochastic stage, not two code states; neither the run-alias collapse (this case collapses nothing) nor the metadata resolver's source rule (it never reaches the byte resolver's exit code) can move it. Carries the tier's third graded harvest assertion.

The sex axis carried entirely by a proxy: the archive declares no sex attribute at all, so hermaphrodite-vs-male survives only as the Him5 marker inside genotype. Pins that a free-text genotype still discriminates after the verbose tissue strings were pruned.

The only real ORIGINAL fixed-offset BD Rhapsody bead. Half of a deliberate pair with GSE282765-colon-crod-wta: both extract protocols name the same instrument ("BD Rhapsody Express Single-Cell Analysis System") and differ only in the declared bead, so deciding BD chemistry from anything but the R1 bytes gets exactly one of the two wrong.

The only real BD Rhapsody ENHANCED library on the 384x3 pools. It closed the -v2 leaf; its 97x3 sibling is now closed by GSE266161-unmod-first-mixing, and the two together with GSE274290 make BD a three-way distinction. Before it, the 0-3bp diversity insert, the GTGA/GACA linkers and the anchored frame recovery had been proven only on reads seqforge generated from its own spec. On real reads the frame phase-locks in 92.6% and the 384x3 pools hit 0.93-0.97 against 0.001 for the disjoint 97x3 pools.
The only bulk paired-end arm — the non-single-cell branch of the modality-general architecture, and the negative control that keeps a barcode-free library from being read as a chemistry.

The only case reaching a non-STARsolo pipeline (map/chromap) from bytes, and the real-data guard on the ATAC barcode geometry: a 24bp barcode read = 8bp lead-in + 16bp CB at offset 8, reverse-complement, matching a DISJOINT ARC-ATAC whitelist. A regression that reverts the geometry fix drops it to bulk-rnaseq.
An over-sequenced 28bp CB+UMI R1 that is told apart from plain 3' v3 ONLY by the ARC whitelist — the corpus's test that a whitelist, not a read geometry, can be the deciding evidence.

The pilot's worked example, and the only accession present in BOTH tiers (evals/cases/real from real FASTQs behind an env var, and here byte-light) — so the two paths must reach the same verdict. The dataset whose single-nucleus label priced the 40.7% gene-only counting defect (ADR-0012).

The only dataset where sex VARIES across samples (3 hermaphrodite + 5 male off one him-8 strain), so it is the one case pinning a per-sample attribute that actually discriminates. Its per-accession claim sits on the minority class, catching a shuffled join 5 times in 8 rather than 3.

Two samples that must never be merged or tidied into each other: QX2314xPTM299_F4 is the F4 eQTL mapping pool, QX2314+PTM299 is the pooled-parents control. The submitter's x-versus-plus notation is load-bearing, and the case exists to stop a future reader "fixing" the spelling.

The only real bd-rhapsody-wta-enhanced-v1 (97x3) library, closing the last synthetic-only BD leaf and making the BD arm a triple: GSE274290 is the original fixed-offset bead, GSE282765-colon-crod-wta is Enhanced on 384x3, this is Enhanced on the disjoint 97x3. Unlike its -v2 sibling, this leaf SHARES its whitelists with the original bead, so the onlist cannot carry it and only the staggered GTGA/GACA linker frame separates the two — the corpus's one real-read test of per-read anchored frame recovery against a live alternative. Organism deliberately unclaimed: a mouse+human barnyard whose BioSample taxonomy_id reads 9606 only because BioSample carries one taxon.

The corpus's only real 10x GEM-X 3' v4 reads, and the only test anywhere of the GEM-X vs 3' v3/v3.1 distinction against the REAL onlist registry — the synthetic spec case registers no whitelist for the competing siblings, so it cannot fail the way this one can. Geometry is identical across v4/v3/v3.1 by construction, so the whitelist at rung 3 is the entire separation (73.11% GEM-X vs 0.81% v3 measured over the full slice; verified against Cell Ranger 10.1.0's own chemistry_defs). PUBLISHED RED AND NOW GREEN, with `outcome` and all nine field claims byte-identical to the pre-registration commit: it was a false_refuse (BARCODE_READ_ABSENT) caused by a SAMPLING defect, not a chemistry one — R1 cycle 2 is dark in 91% of the first 2000 reads and resolve samples exactly those, scoring 7.90% against an 8.583% admission bar. Fixed by dropping windows the sequencer never called from the hit rate's denominator (same 2000 reads now score 91.33%); DEFAULT_MAX_READS is still 2000, and probe's falsified 'chemistry is invariant from 1k reads' rationale was rewritten rather than the budget raised. Also a second C. elegans EMBRYO dataset beside GSE126954, three chemistry generations apart on identical biology.

The corpus's only chemistry that cannot be decided from bytes at ANY rung, and so its only real decide reached through a hypothesis rather than through the evidence matrix (GSE208154, the only other hypothesis case, refuses). 10x 5' v2 and 3' v2 share the 26bp geometry, the 737K-august-2016 whitelist FILE and a byte-identical signature, differing only in soloStrand, which no probe observes; Cell Ranger 10.1.0's own chemistry_defs confirms SC3Pv2 and SC5P-R2 identical field for field except strandedness. Also the first NON-ILLUMINA package in either tier (DNBSEQ-G400, MGI). With GSE310378-provsv-gfp-til it forms the corpus's first pair whose correct compiled parameter is soloStrand Reverse.

The only real 10x-5p-gex-v3 library, and the byte-decided half of the 5' family's two-case coverage — its GSE317744 sibling has no byte path at all, so one case structurally cannot cover both leaves. The only real test of distinguishable_by: [onlist] for the 5' family: a 28bp R1 structurally identical to FOUR 3'-side entries, separated only by 3M-5pgex-jan-2023 at 0.6221% / 6.8745% / 0.0000% overlap — the 6.87% against GEM-X v4 is the closest pair in the KB. Its record also declares I1/I2 that the archive does not hold, the mirror image of GSE229022, and its SRA study title is a stale pre-release placeholder so the title is deliberately unclaimed.

The corpus's first plate-based, PRE-DEMULTIPLEXED assay — the cell barcode is the FILE, not a read — and its only many-experiment package: 96 SRX / 96 BioSamples / 96 samples under one --multi-experiment assertion, against 1-8 samples everywhere else. PUBLISHED RED AND PRE-REGISTERED (ADR-0018): measured on ten cells of this deposit seqforge decides the generic bulk chemistry at exit 0, 0.899 vs 0.511, nothing raised, and compose selects map/star — a bulk gene-count matrix for a single-cell experiment, most confident on the cleanest cells. The 96-element experiment.samples.*.strain multiset is claimed for its LENGTH: every attribute this deposit declares is constant across the cells, so it catches a plate that collapsed to one sample or split into two manifests, not a shuffled join. EXCLUDED FROM THE FROZEN-18 GRADE DIGEST (seqforge.evals.digest): a red nineteenth case moves n_cases, the per-case list and false_accept_rate at once. Selected on archive-declared facts only — the 96 lexicographically-lowest run accessions of 1440 (SRR19884905-SRR19885000), executable as build-package.sh in the case dir. No cell in the draw is below min_input_reads, so the starved-well path is NOT covered here; that is the hermetic tier's, by construction. Built at -n 2000 rather than the tier's 20000 because 96 cells multiply it (~31 MB against ~315 MB), which also means the package cannot serve a probe budget above 2000 without a rebuild.
